radiusSource: Radius 0.6751 +/- 0.063 solar radii from Mistry et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2459 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....9M/abstract): 469,667 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
